messages:
mira: ran quick AB on copilot-v2 (fp16) vs copilot-v2-int8 hybrid. Need a one-paragraph + scorecard for GTN.

diego: tl;dr: int8 gives ~35% unit cost reduction, median latency -40ms, but some edit-heavy sessions degrade ~1.2% quality on named-entity continuity.

yuki: paste perf slice (dedicated A100): ```
fp16: 1100 tok/s, med 120ms, p99 460ms
int8-hybrid: 1500 tok/s (+36%), med 78ms, p99 340ms
unit cost est: fp16 $0.00175 -> hybrid-int8 $0.00114 (-34.9%)
```

mira: quality slices: single-turn Q/A delta ~0.0-0.2%. multi-turn editing (turns>5) delta cluster around -0.9 to -1.4% (NER continuity). summarization minor -0.3 ROUGE1.

rahul: product asks: can we do a per-session policy that starts int8 then elevates to fp16 on edit/NER detection? cheaper and less disruptive than static slice routing.

diego: yes — can implement cheap detector: if msg contains >2 named entities or user edits previous bot text, promote to fp16. cost of detector negligible.

ops-bot: staging soak (hybrid) 45m: no crashes, autoscale stable, median latency improved. logs: ```WARN: 2% transient tokenization mismatch alerts (investigate)```

yuki: econ sim: for 200M monthly tokens, shifting 80% to hybrid-int8 (with dynamic promote for ~20% of those) nets ~$90k/mo savings gross; conservative estimate after promotions ~$50k/mo.

mira: proposed rollout: 5% canary -> 20% -> 60% over 10 days, enable dynamic promotion detector at canary start, measure PDQ/CTR and a small eval job nightly on a 5k prompt sample. auto-fallback if utility_drop >=1% sustained 12h.

diego: scorecard snippet for PD: ```
Scorecard (hybrid-int8 vs fp16)
- Unit cost delta: -34.9%
- Median latency: 78ms vs 120ms
- p99: 340ms vs 460ms
- Multi-turn NER continuity: -1.2% (turns>5)
- Summarization ROUGE1: -0.3
Operational recs:
- Start 5% canary with dynamic promote detector
- Nightly sampled eval + auto-alert at 0.5% PDQ drop
- Force fp16 if session flagged by detector
```

rahul: can ops drop the flagset? want to paste into routing config.

ops-bot: routing flagset (paste-ready): `{\n  "strategy":"dynamic_session_promote",\n  "canary_pct":5,\n  "ramp_days":10,\n  "promote_rules":["edits_detected","named_entities_>2","session_turns_>5"],\n  "utility_threshold_pct":1.0,\n  "pdq_alert_pct":0.5\n}`

mira: ok ill send to GTN with the paragraph: "Recommend hybrid int8 with dynamic per-session promotion to fp16: yields ~35% unit-cost improvement and meaningful latency gains while keeping critical edit/NER sessions on higher fidelity. Begin 5% canary, enable detector, and monitor nightly evals; auto-fallback on sustained >1% utility loss." :+1:
